notes.title: Tyrant's Realm – Free Content Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, warriors of the Realm![/h1]

A brand-new free content update has arrived in Tyrant’s Realm, bringing fresh challenges and rewards to those brave enough to face them. Whether you’re a seasoned fighter or a newcomer looking to sharpen your skills, this update has something for everyone. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Master the Art of Boss Parrying[/h2]

Test your reflexes against the fiercest foes! The long-requested Boss Parrying system is now live, giving you the power to counter and turn the tide of battle against even the deadliest adversaries. Precision and timing are key—perfect your parries and dominate the battlefield!

[h2]New Challenges for High Difficulty Modes[/h2]

For those seeking an even greater test of skill, we’ve introduced new challenges for the highest difficulty levels. Sharpen your strategies, push your limits, and prove you have what it takes to conquer the Realm’s toughest trials.

[h2]24 New Challenge Chest Rewards & New Cosmetic Outfits[/h2]

Complete the Challenges and unlock 24 brand-new rewards from Challenge Chests! These exclusive items will push you to complete objectives faster and more efficiently—only the most dedicated challengers will claim them all.

Additionally, the Challenge Chest now holds new cosmetic outfits, allowing you to customize your warrior’s look as you battle through the Realm. Earn them by completing challenges and stand out among your fellow champions.

[h3]Update Now and Prove Your Might![/h3]

This free update is available now—jump back into Tyrant’s Realm and test your skills against these new trials. Let us know what you think, and as always, we’ll see you in the fight!

Stay sharp, stay relentless, and rule the Realm!

notes.title: Tyrant’s Realm Update – Steam Deck Verified & More!
notes.notes:
Adventurers, we have some exciting updates for you!

[h2]Steam Deck Verified![/h2]
Tyrant’s Realm is now officially Steam Deck Verified! This means you can take your adventure on the go with full support for controls, performance, and UI. Whether you’re battling through dungeons or strategizing for your next fight, you can now do it anywhere, anytime.

[h2]Steam Trading Cards Are Now Live![/h2]
The wait is over—Steam Trading Cards for Tyrant’s Realm have arrived! Start collecting cards as you play, trade with friends, and unlock exclusive badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons to show off your Realm achievements. Who will be the first to collect them all?

[h2]Ongoing QoL Fixes & Future Content Updates[/h2]
We’re committed to continuously improving your experience in Tyrant’s Realm. Expect minor quality-of-life improvements in upcoming patches to refine gameplay, enhance performance, and address player feedback. But that’s not all—we’re also shifting our focus towards larger content updates in the future. Stay tuned for new features, mechanics, and surprises as we continue expanding the world of Tyrant’s Realm!

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means everything, and we can't wait to share what’s next. Keep conquering, strategizing, and forging your legend!

notes.title: Tyrant's Realm Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Tyrant's Realm Adventurers![/h1]

We’re thrilled to finally reveal that Tyrant's Realm will officially launch on [b]January 16[/b]! Mark your calendars and get ready to immerse yourself in the full experience of our dark-fantasy world filled with epic battles, deep lore, and gripping mysteries.

[h2] What to Expect at Launch:[/h2]

[b][list]
[*] Explore an even richer, more immersive environment packed with danger and discovery.
[*] Battle new and even more fearsome enemies using powerful abilities.
[*] Discover untold secrets and unravel the dark history behind the Tyrant’s Realm.
[/list][/b]
🛡️ The journey you’ve started in the demo is just the beginning—prepare for new surprises, deeper challenges, and intense action when the full game releases.

[h2]🔥 Release Date: January 16 🔥[/h2]

Until then, if you haven’t yet, be sure to check out the Tyrant's Realm Demo on our store page to get a head start. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so please share your thoughts!

[h2]🔗 Download the Demo Here[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416810/Tyrants_Realm_Prelude_Demo/

Prepare to face the Tyrant. Your realm awaits on [b]January 16[/b].
